process

How I approach a problem

Mirrors the actual sequence from the AI Fluency track — framing before building.

frame

Ask the real question

Start from a research-question framing pass — what are we actually trying to learn, and what would count as evidence?

audit

Audit the workflow

Map the current process end to end (FL-01 style) before touching code, so I know where the real bottleneck is.

build

Model & validate

Build the smallest version that tests the hypothesis, then check it against real data rather than assuming.

prove

Write the proof statement

Close with a clear statement of what was shown, what wasn't, and what I'd do differently next time.
